# Thirukkural Tamil Dataset

> The Tamil text of all 1,330 kurals of Thiruvalluvar's Thirukkural (திருக்குறள்), in Unicode NFC with permanent ids tk:0001 to tk:1330, checked against three 19th-century printed editions where sources differ. Separate tables add public-domain English translations by G. U. Pope (1886), W. H. Drew and John Lazarus, and V. V. S. Aiyar (1916), Parimelazhagar's Tamil commentary, metre analysis, variant readings, a ruling ledger, and a sha256 and Merkle proof for every kural. Core licence CC0-1.0. No text is model output.

Release 1.0.0 (2026-10-20). kurals_root_sha256: 86d8d109697176ee8d15150255c76265cbb5a067546215210c974fee49c6a1df

## Data

- [kurals.jsonl](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/data/core/kurals.jsonl): one JSON object per kural: id, number, lines_ta, text_status, adjudication_ids, provenance
- [adhikarams.jsonl](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/data/core/adhikarams.jsonl): the 133 chapters with Tamil names and English titles from Pope 1886
- [pope1886-en.jsonl](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/data/layers/pope1886-en.jsonl): G. U. Pope's English verse translation, one row per kural
- [drew-lazarus-en.jsonl](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/data/layers/drew-lazarus-en.jsonl): Drew and Lazarus English prose translation
- [aiyar1916-en.jsonl](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/data/layers/aiyar1916-en.jsonl): V. V. S. Aiyar's English translation
- [parimelazhagar-ta.jsonl](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/data/layers/parimelazhagar-ta.jsonl): Parimelazhagar's Tamil commentary
- [croissant.json](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/release/croissant.json): Croissant 1.1 metadata with Responsible AI fields

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/README.md): overview, formats, quick start
- [Data dictionary](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/docs/data-dictionary.md): every table and field
- [Sources](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/docs/sources.md): editions and digital sources, text_status values, what is checked
- [Licensing](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/docs/licensing.md): licence per table
- [FAQ](https://thirukkural.ashwingopalsamy.in/faq/)
- [Website](https://thirukkural.ashwingopalsamy.in/): one page per kural and per chapter
- [llms-full.txt](https://thirukkural.ashwingopalsamy.in/llms-full.txt): the key facts, fields, loading code and tools in one file

## Evidence

- [Ruling ledger](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/provenance/ledger/adjudications.jsonl): every ruling with candidates, sources and evidence
- [Source registry](https://github.com/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/blob/main/provenance/registry/sources.json): every source with lineage, licence and file hashes
